title: Miura-ori, skewed pleat
note: Accordion in one direction, then pleat the strip along slanted lines. The skew gives Miura-ori its single degree of freedom and its use in solar arrays and stents. After the vertical pleat the paper is a strip at x in [0.75, 1], so the slanted offsets are chosen to fall inside THAT strip's own range, not the square's.
